correctness.rationale: The Kummer 16-node 16-trope incidence and action of the six Weierstrass roots are explicitly reconstructed from known theta-characteristic geometry. The reduced 31-by-31 graph Laplacian M presents the degree-zero graph critical group. The action matrix U in sink basis yields a 31-by-62 integral presentation [M|U-I] of coinvariants. The perfect invariant monodromy pairing identifies the abstract invariant factors of Frobenius fixed points with these coinvariants. For all eleven S6 conjugacy classes, 9,275 elementary unimodular row/column operations were stored and successfully replayed to exact positive Smith diagonals with all off-diagonals zero and divisibility, verifying all exact factors and orders. Identity size equals 3*2^72 from independent Laplacian spectrum. No unproved genericity or finite-experiment extrapolation is used.

originality.rationale: A prior complete geometric critical-group invariant-factor calculation was discovered and explicitly excluded as the contribution, as were prior Göpel tetrad Frobenius cycles. Kumar (2006) and Malmendier (2009 preprint) supply geometric labels, not eleven fixed sandpile groups. Targeted searches of related integral Frobenius coinvariant results on other geometric graphs, folded cube aliases, and arithmetic Kummer papers did not reveal an exact match. Complete all-type Frobenius fixed-group isomorphism classification is a strictly stronger arithmetical statement than the known total graph critical group. Historical priority remains provisional because unindexed equivalent graph action calculations are possible.
residual_risks: Full historical priority of the all-S6 arithmetic Kummer graph-Jacobian actions is not independently certified; specialized folded-cube/biplane graph tables could contain equivalent calculations.

value.rationale: The complete Frobenius-fixed critical group is a natural arithmetic graph-divisor invariant of the canonical genus-two Kummer 16_6 incidence configuration. Eleven complete arithmetic cases give ten distinct exact integral isomorphism types and cover every possible six-Weierstrass-point Frobenius factorization. Groups of equal order (e.g. types 2^2 1^2 and 2^3) are provably nonisomorphic, showing substantive structure not seen in earlier geometric critical-group invariant factors, graph spectra or point-count data. The calculation gives exact Galois-invariant chip-firing obstruction groups and is not an arbitrary unmotivated subcase.
